description: This file defines a configuration class for AI/ML image generation using the AIML API, including methods for parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

classes.name: AimlImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for AIML API image generation, providing methods for parameter support, URL generation, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns list of supported OpenAI parameters for the AIML API.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to AIML API parameters, supporting conversion and optional dropping of unsupported params.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the image generation API request.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and sets up necessary environment variables and headers for API requests.

methods.name: transform_image_generation_request
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into the request body for the AIML image generation API.

methods.name: transform_image_generation_response
methods.description: Parses and converts the API response into the internal ImageResponse format, handling multiple response formats.
